# Fixtures

## TRAINING EXERCISE — NOT AN ACTUAL INCIDENT

**These are not the exercise.** They are throwaway geometry, generated by
`scripts/make_fires.py` from one template scenario rotated, scaled and moved to
each fire's position in `config/fires.yml`.

They exist for one reason: so the derivation and product pipeline can be run end
to end **before any real geometry is drawn**, and so a broken pipeline is caught
by a test rather than at 0400 on exercise day.

The real exercise data goes in `data/drawn/<colour>/`, drawn in ArcGIS Pro per
[../../docs/10-digitizing-guide.md](../../docs/10-digitizing-guide.md).

## Regenerating

```bash
python3 scripts/make_fires.py
python3 scripts/derive_tactical.py --all --in data/fixtures
python3 scripts/validate_event_data.py
```

Do not hand-edit. `GISAcres` and `LengthMiles` are computed from the geometry,
and the validator fails if a stored value drifts from what the geometry measures.

## What each folder holds

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `eventpoint.geojson` | 45 features — ICP, camp, helispots, drop points, hazards, structures |
| `eventline.geojson` | 17 drawn + derived — line, edges, routes, division breaks |
| `eventpolygon.geojson` | 15 — three daily perimeters, TFR, closures, evac zones, repair areas |
| `trails.geojson` | Stand-in for USFS `TrailNFS_Publish` |
| `roads.geojson` | Stand-in for USFS `RoadCore` |
| `fire.json` | Resolved metadata the layouts' dynamic text binds to |

`trails.geojson` and `roads.geojson` are **not map data**. They exist so the
"trail on the fire edge becomes hand line" rule has something to run against.
Some deliberately follow the perimeter so the rule has a positive case; the Old
Mine Trail runs straight through the burn with `LINE_STATUS = none` so the
manual override has a negative case.

Replace both with the real USFS layers clipped to the AOI once you have them.

| Green | 07/31 night | 1,430 | 4.00 mi |
| Blue | 08/01 day | 2,335 | 5.10 mi |
| Indigo | 08/02 day | 1,130 | 3.55 mi |
